notes: Fetch of PitchBook, Carta, TechCrunch, SEC, Lenny pages was blocked (WebFetch domain denied), so values come from search-result text, not the documents; entries flagged verified:false or 'snippet only' need checking against the PDFs. Gaps: no annual seed series for 2005-2009, 2011-2012, 2014-2018, 2020, 2023 (PitchBook implies ~7.0M for 2018 from +14.3% to 8.0M, not recorded as data). All valuations are PitchBook pre-money medians; Carta gives quarterly pre-money (e.g. 16M Q4 2024) and post-money. No direct figure for lead/seed investor ownership; only ~20% new-money share (excludes SAFE holders). No official YC shutdown/unicorn statement after 2015; YC's own 5.5% unicorn claim unverified. Source switches: PitchBook (<=2022) to Carta (2023+) not yet reconciled.
